mostWorthwhile.text: Following glucose from storage as glycogen to release into the blood made the liver’s role between meals clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the portal vessel was predictable and gave little immediate explanation beyond the connection itself.

surprise.text: Nothing was particularly surprising; the sequence followed the goals and item names closely.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although adding blood transport felt like a separate step for a route already suggested by the liver releasing glucose.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter to see how the connected systems interact, though the predictable combinations make the decisions less engaging.
